events.title: 0.3.0 - Patch Notes
events.summary: 0.3.0 - Patch Notes- Added Japanese and Simplified Chinese localization - menus, all coupons and the tutorial- Pick your interface language from a grid of pixel-art flags in Settings- VS BOTS: Choose the number of bots on the screen that opens after VS BOTS- Shop price tags are now dark with cream text and easier to read- The room code box is wider, so the hint text fits- Fixed Chinese or Japanese letters staying on screen after switching to another language- Shortened texts that didn't fit thei

events.title: 0.2.1 - Patch Notes
events.summary: - VS BOTS: Bots now adapt to the clock - when time runs short they hurry and still answer, but rushing makes them misspell more- VS BOTS: Sabotage coupons now work on bots - every audio or typing sabotage you play on a bot lowers its chance of getting the word right- VS BOTS: Stop Sign now works on bots too - they have to wait it out before typing- VS BOTS: Longer words take bots longer to type- VS BOTS: Every bot now has its own personality for the whole match - some type fast but sloppy, other

events.title: 0.2.0 - Demo Patch Notes
events.summary: - Added a Tutorial (top of the Play menu) - ClackO walks you through your first match- Reworked Avatar Studio: Pencil/Eraser/Fill/Picker/Line tools, undo/redo, mirror drawing, Surprise button, in-game preview- VS BOTS: Shop and coupon phase are no longer timed - press PASS when you're ready- PASS buttons now pulse- Playing a coupon is clearer: valid targets pulse and show a USE button, plus a hint line- Added ACTIVE x/3 and PASSIVE x/2 slot counters- Passive coupons now have a gold name box- Sho
